analysis: The only change in docs/developer/test.md is at head lines 1049-1050, in the 'SDK 27 Release Qualification' section. It updates the toolchain wording from 'SDK 27 / Swift 6.4' to 'SDK 27.2 / Swift 6.4.2 (Xcode 27.2, the `release` toolchain)' and adds a link to build.md#sdk-27-release-builds-and-caches. This is documentation only. It changes no code, workflow, signing, entitlement, attestation, key-handling or coordinator wire behavior. I read the rest of both units as unchanged context: the add-on hold, App Attest dispatch, native qualification, cluster and release-test descriptions. Nothing in them is modified, so no threat-model entry is affected (TB-011, T-053, T-054, T-041, T-059 and T-060 are untouched). The text still says qualification and physical Apple gates are distinct, and it does not claim any new qualification. Open question for integration: the link target build.md#sdk-27-release-builds-and-caches and the actual CI toolchain pin are outside the supplied evidence, so I cannot confirm that the documented version matches the real release toolchain. That is a documentation accuracy question, not a security regression.
